d:
A doctor struggles.
1910, Manchuria, China. An outbreak of the plague has swept through the region, and people are dying in alarming numbers. Dr. Wu is a young physician, trained in the West and trying to save lives alongside traditional healers, who are suspicious of his training. He's begun to formulate a theory about the disease, believing it is transmitted through particles in the air, but he can't be sure without examining a cadaver. But the master healer, Master Yao, won't let him, seeing the process of cutting a dead body as barbaric.
